mentions.name: Plukio
mentions.description: Plukio is a lightweight alternative to Etsy built in Elixir, an online marketplace for handmade goods such as pottery and jewelry. It addresses the lack of an equivalent to "old Etsy", where handmade sellers have otherwise turned to custom websites and Instagram. A mailing list exists for launch, with local makers in Portland expressing interest.
mentions.problem: There is no equivalent for "old Etsy"; people who sell handmade pottery and jewelry have had to turn to custom websites and Instagram.
mentions.audience: Handmade sellers such as pottery and jewelry makers looking for an "old Etsy"-style venue instead of custom websites or Instagram.
